subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) He checked the baggage of some of the passengers and found nothing. (b) It was getting on for midnight. (c) At last there was only one passenger left. (d) Mr. Rahman is a customs officer. (e) A flight arrived from Bankok. (f) All the passangers got down with their luggage. (g) One night he was on duty at Shahjalal International Airport. (h) So Mr. Rahman felt tired and sleepy. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
guide_solution: Reordering sentences (d) + (g) + (b) + (h) + (e) + (f) + (a) + (c) Section B : Writing Test
